answer: Each claim must hang from its own vine, and all vines answering the same entry are tied into one bundle in the mirror, the record anyone can check. The willow above the bundle is tugged by the last close's hash, so it bends to one vine drawn at random, and only that vine is graded for the bundle. If the drawn vine snaps, its reflection in the mirror does not match its claim; the bundle fails, so salting one good vine among 49 copies is caught 49 times out of 50. To lift its chance above 2%, a farm must make every vine passable, doing the work 50 times over.
